name: Sculpfun S9 5W
tagline: 5W Sculpfun's proven budget line : still popular for value-focused makers
tldr: Sculpfun S9 5W is the 5W SKU on the Sculpfun sculpfun s9 line. Before S30 Ultra, the S9 was Sculpfun's workhorse. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal : occasional thin cuts only

priceRange.note: 5W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Lowest S9 entry for engraving tests
cons: S9 10W is usually the better buy new
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 5W SKU on Sculpfun S9. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S9 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 3 mm+ cutting in production : see 10W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
